title: Hands-free trunk opening and trunk lid operation
summary: Feedback centers on the hands-free trunk feature and trunk lid operation, with positive comments about feature availability and use instructions but several complaints about inconsistent foot-sensor response and difficult opening or closing, while many sampled mentions are too brief or service-oriented to determine sentiment clearly.

positive.summary: Positive reviews highlight that the kick-to-open trunk feature is available and can work when the proper key presence and foot motion are used.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on the hands-free trunk sensor working inconsistently and on the trunk being hard to open or close.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention trunk opening failures, repairs, rattles, missing closure controls, or general feature references without enough context to classify sentiment confidently.

limitations: Most sampled mentions are undetermined, so the evidence is limited for drawing a fuller sentiment picture.
The topic mixes hands-free kick sensor behavior, trunk lid hardware or repairs, and general trunk feature mentions rather than one single tightly defined issue.
Some examples are truncated or service-note style fragments, which limits confidence about the reviewer’s intended sentiment.
